verdict.rationale: Jeeves clearly supports instant virtual card issuance with spend limits, and card-level controls can scope spend (limits, reset intervals, naming), including via MCP for AI-assisted issuance. However, there's no explicit documentation of vendor-lock or category-lock (restricting a card to a single vendor/merchant category like ad spend specifically), only general spend limits and naming. Missing for 10: explicit merchant/category-locking or vendor-restriction controls, and independent/hands-on confirmation of instant issuance UX.
